package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/x509"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/user"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// This program runs inside the final runtime. It needs neither a shell nor
// utilities, so scratch receives exactly the same evidence checks as Alpine.
func main() {
	must := func(err error) {
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
	check := func(ok bool, message string) {
		if !ok {
			panic(message)
		}
	}
	check(os.Getuid() != 0, "runtime must be non-root")
	u, err := user.Current()
	must(err)
	check(u.Username == "appuser", "user records missing")
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "runtime-proof-")
	must(err)
	must(f.Close())
	must(os.Remove(f.Name()))
	f, err = os.CreateTemp(u.HomeDir, "runtime-proof-")
	must(err)
	must(f.Close())
	must(os.Remove(f.Name()))
	roots, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
	must(err)
	check(len(roots.Subjects()) > 0, "CA trust roots missing")
	const evidence = "/usr/share/codefly/build/"
	for _, name := range []string{"modules.json", "binaries.txt", "sources.sha256", "go.mod"} {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(evidence + name)
		must(err)
		check(len(b) > 0, "empty build evidence: "+name)
	}
	_, err = os.Stat(evidence + "go.sum")
	must(err)
	manifest, err := os.Open(evidence + "runtime.sha256")
	must(err)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(manifest)
	count := 0
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.SplitN(scanner.Text(), "  ", 2)
		check(len(fields) == 2, "invalid runtime hash entry")
		b, err := os.ReadFile(fields[1])
		must(err)
		check(fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) == fields[0], "runtime bytes differ: "+fields[1])
		count++
	}
	must(scanner.Err())
	must(manifest.Close())
	check(count >= 3, "runtime inventory must include app, asset and command")
	// The fixture is static and has no OS-package declaration. Finding these
	// files means an OS-bearing final stage leaked through, even if it boots.
	for _, name := range []string{"/bin/sh", "/sbin/apk", "/lib/apk/db/installed", "/etc/os-release"} {
		_, err := os.Stat(name)
		check(os.IsNotExist(err), "unexpected OS payload: "+name)
	}
	libs, err := filepath.Glob("/lib/ld-musl-*")
	must(err)
	check(len(libs) == 0, "unexpected native loader")
	metadata, err := os.ReadFile(evidence + "binaries.txt")
	must(err)
	fmt.Print("command-present\n", string(metadata))
}
